response.sql:
WITH project_counts AS (
  SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) as qc_count
  FROM scanqc
  WHERE arcref IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY arcref
),
totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(qc_count) as total_qc, COUNT(*) as num_projects
  FROM project_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT pc.arcref, pc.qc_count,
    CAST(pc.qc_count AS REAL) / t.total_qc as share,
    1.0 / t.num_projects as avg_share
  FROM project_counts pc
  CROSS JOIN totals t
)
SELECT arcref, qc_count as count, share, share - avg_share as deviation
FROM with_shares
ORDER BY deviation DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The grouping counts only QC records where arcref IS NOT NULL, treating NULL arcref as not representing a valid project and thus excluded from both project count and total QC record count.

alternatives.interpretation: Include QC records with NULL arcref as a separate project group in the grouping and calculations.
